import unittest
from btree.tree import PersistentBTree

class TestBTree(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_immutable_insert(self):
        t1 = PersistentBTree()
        t2 = t1.insert("a", 1)
        t3 = t2.insert("b", 2)
        self.assertIsNone(t1.get("a"))
        self.assertEqual(t2.get("a"), 1)
        self.assertIsNone(t2.get("b"))
        self.assertEqual(t3.get("a"), 1)
        self.assertEqual(t3.get("b"), 2)

if __name__ == '__main__': unittest.main()
